activity.notes: Kiyosi Itô (1915-09-07 to 2008-11-10) initiated his stochastic-process work in 1942, and pursued research during his Japanese Statistics Bureau/Nagoya Imperial University period (1943 appointment) through his 1945 doctorate. The first foundational paper was published in 1942. This is an academic/research contribution in then-Empire of Japan, not governance or military service. Later Kyoto University professorship is a distinct Activity.
